settings.purpose: Organize preferences, account controls, notification rules, integrations, and dangerous actions into predictable groups with clear save behavior.
useWhen: Users configure durable product, account, workspace, notification, or security preferences.
Controls need grouping, descriptions, immediate vs saved behavior, and confirmation.
Dangerous or irreversible actions need visual separation and recovery policy.
doNotUseWithoutReview: The UI is a one-off form rather than durable settings.
Immediate and saved changes are mixed without feedback.
Danger zone actions are placed with normal preferences.
Controls are unlabeled or depend on icon/color only.
foundations: Defines group spacing, row density, control alignment, and responsive stacking.
Owns setting labels, descriptions, confirmation copy, Toast messages, and danger copy.
Controls group surface, focus, danger zone, disabled, and changed states.
Immediate, dirty, saving, saved, error, disabled, and destructive states are explicit.
Danger tone is reserved for irreversible or high-risk actions.
Every row associates label/description with its control and preserves keyboard focus.
slots: Label, description, control, state, and feedback.
Declares whether changes save instantly or require submit.
Confirms saved changes, failures, and undo when available.
Separated destructive actions with confirmation and recovery policy.
Mobile stacks rows; desktop can use grouped panels.
variants: Switch/select changes save immediately and report Toast feedback.
Dirty state is tracked and saved with a primary action.
Destructive actions are separated and confirmed.
motion: Toast or inline state appears after change; reduced motion avoids decorative entrance.
Changed rows update immediately without layout shift.
Dialog/sheet opens after user action with focus management.
accessibility: Each setting has a visible label and associated description.
Immediate changes announce success or failure.
Danger actions require confirmation and named consequence.
Keyboard navigation follows row order and does not trap focus.
tests: Immediate setting saves and shows feedback.
Explicit-save setting tracks dirty state and blocks duplicate submit.
Danger action is separated and requires confirmation.
Mobile rows stack without losing labels/descriptions.
Screen reader labels include setting name and state.
Disabled settings explain why they cannot change.

canDecide: Group settings when labels, descriptions, and save behavior are explicit.
Use immediate save for simple reversible toggles with clear feedback.
Separate danger actions when destructive risk is present.
mustAsk: Save behavior, permission policy, danger consequence, account/session impact, or recovery is unclear.
Settings affect billing, security, identity, access, compliance, or integrations.
rejectIf: A setting has no visible label.
Immediate and explicit save behavior are mixed without state.
Danger action appears as a normal row.
miel.handoff: Confirm setting groups, row labels, save model, permissions, feedback, danger actions, and responsive organization.
